:hat: Hat — an estimator or a unit vector.
:widehat: Wide hat, for expressions longer than one symbol.
:bar: Bar — a mean, closure, or conjugate.
:tilde: Tilde — a modified version of an object.
:dot: Single dot — the first time derivative.
:ddot: Double dot — the second time derivative.
:underbrace: Brace below an expression with a label under it.
:overbrace: Brace above an expression with a label over it.
:overset: Places the first argument above the second.
:underset: Places the first argument below the second.
:rm: Upright roman — units and multi-letter names.
:sf: Sans-serif — categories, or the transpose T.
:frak: Fraktur — Lie algebras, ideals, prime ideals.
:bb: Blackboard bold, for any letter not in the list above.
